attribution_limitations: The sentence reporting a heterozygous PKD1 mutation follows the older brother C3 sentence but does not name who carries it, while Table 3 prints X for the older brother and O, hetero for the patient, mother and younger sister.

The C3 variant protein change is printed p.Ser336AlafsTer32 in Table 2 and p.Ser336AlagsTer32 in Table 3 for the same C3 row with the same reference sequence; the one-character difference ('fs' versus 'gs') reads as a print artefact rather than a second variant.

The case text says NGS revealed variants of the C3, FBN2 and MFAP5 genes, while Table 2 also lists a PKD1 variant of uncertain significance in the patient and the family sequencing covered C3, PKD1, FBN2 and MFAP5.
Table 3 uses O and X symbols (with hetero for heterozygous) but its footnote defines only the gene names and het.
The discussion says only symptomatic treatments such as angiotensin converting enzyme antagonists could be used, while the case text records losartan, described as an angiotensin receptor antagonist.

The Fig. 1 treatment bar for mycophenolate mofetil appears to begin well before the June 12, 2021 start date given in the text (the bar starts near the mid-2020 axis ticks and ends near the end of 2021); chart positions are visual estimates and the figure caption states no dates.
The cyclosporine discontinuation and losartan reduction are linked to symptoms exhibited by November 14, 2020, but the date of the discontinuation itself is not stated.

The older brother is described as having only microscopic hematuria in the case text and intermittent microscopic hematuria in the discussion; the discussion also says C3GN was strongly suspected although no kidney biopsy was done.
The discussion calls for confirming the mutation in the older brother and performing a renal biopsy if needed without naming whose biopsy is meant.
